create_BasicMAC: create a BasicMAC multi-agent controller that shares parameters between agents using a registered agent and action selector
select_actions_BasicMAC: select actions for agents in an episode batch using the forward pass and action selector
forward_BasicMAC: run the forward pass to compute agent outputs with softmax and epsilon floor for policy logits
save_models_BasicMAC: save the agent model state dict to a file path for later loading and checkpointing
load_models_BasicMAC: load the agent model state dict from a saved file path to restore training progress
